ideas.pitch: A localized predictive analytics engine using Poisson GAM and rolling backtests to forecast regional infrastructure and energy load anomalies in Michigan during severe winter weather.
ideas.title: SpartanGrid AI Incident Forecaster
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact hard engineering pattern from the Apart Research AI Forecasting win by utilizing statistical modeling and calibrated prediction intervals instead of a generic wrapper.

ideas.pitch: An AWS-powered graph intelligence and LightGBM platform designed to detect suspicious peer-to-peer financial transactions and grant allocation fraud in university student organizations.
ideas.title: CampusShield AML & Fraud Graph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages complex graph intelligence and explainable machine learning proven to win financial and AI innovation hackathons.

ideas.pitch: A multi-agent student support and sustainability tracker using LangGraph and RAG to audit and optimize campus building energy consumption and waste reduction initiatives.
ideas.title: Midwest GreenNovation Multi-Agent Advisor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the winning multi-agent RAG architecture from the GreenNovation Hackathon to solve a practical university-level challenge that local judges will immediately appreciate.

ideas.pitch: An automated satellite imagery analysis tool that monitors agricultural land use changes and environmental compliance across rural Michigan counties.
ideas.title: AgriSustain Satellite Land Monitor
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the technical execution of the Xcelerate Hackathon runner-up by integrating geospatial APIs for high-impact environmental monitoring.

ideas.pitch: An AI-powered nutrition and wellness platform tailored for university dining halls, delivering real-time personalized meal recommendations based on student dietary restrictions and fitness goals.
ideas.title: NutriCampus Personalized Wellness Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Uses the fast-turnaround consumer utility model that successfully won the Mealzy 24-Hour Hackathon within a tight time window.
